title: Anova's Create Aeronautics Modpack
description: Modpack for Create Aeronautics & other fun engineering Mods.
body:
Just a collection of mods for having fun with engineering projects on a server with friends!

This is my first modpack, and it's probably buggy, but should at least launch and run.

This modpack includes:
- create, aeronautics, and other related create mods
- Mekanism's main components
- sophisticated backpacks & storage
- Applied Energistics 2
- A handful of fun worldgen mods
- various QoL mods
- and a bunch of performance mods

Note: Set the RAM for java to at least 4GB. 8GB or more is recommended.
